sens_en: to twist, to wring, to hang
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 絞 « étrangler » et le compose de 交, croiser, et 糸, le fil. Deux fils croisés et serrés : tordre, essorer, 绞干. 交 se lit jiāo, sur la même syllabe que jiǎo, et porte aussi le sens.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 絞 as “to strangle” and builds it from 交, to cross, and 糸, thread. Two strands crossed and pulled tight: to twist, to wring, 绞干. 交 is read jiāo, the same syllable as jiǎo, and carries the meaning too.
